caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a decorative design. The chest appears to be constructed from wood and features prominent vertical and horizontal framing that forms rectangular panels on the front and side surfaces. Each rectangular panel is bordered with a zig-zag or triangular pattern. The chest rests on four square legs and has a flat, slightly overhanging lid. At the center of the front of the chest, there is an ornamental metal plate with a keyhole, suggesting a locking mechanism. The image is rendered in shades of black, white, and gray, with darker tones used to create shadows and highlight the three-dimensional structure of the object, while the background is plain and unadorned.
title: Chest
